title: Ni modo
desc: The drain is still blocked and the water is in the house
setting: August, the second flood this year, and Lucía is sweeping water out of the back room.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Se mojó el colchón otra vez.

options.es: Ya lo saqué al patio. ¿Qué más agarro?
options.en: I have already taken it out to the yard. What else shall I grab?
options.feedback: Doing before saying. In the first ten minutes of a flood nobody wants an opinion.
Agreement while she sweeps. Pick something up.

options.es: Es que la alcaldía no hace nada.
options.en: The thing is the town hall does nothing.
options.feedback: True, and there is water in the room. That conversation is for tomorrow.

options.es: Ni modo pues. Pasame la escoba grande.
options.en: Ni modo then. Pass me the big broom.
options.feedback: You took the word and got back to work with it. That is exactly what ni modo is for.

options.en: (go on carrying things out in silence)
options.feedback: Fine, and the word was an invitation to be in it together.

options.es: ¿Cómo que ni modo? Hay que reclamar.
options.en: What do you mean, ni modo? We have to complain.
options.feedback: Marcos went eleven times in six years. Ni modo is answer number twelve, not the first.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: (al día siguiente, con café) ¿Vamos el lunes a la alcaldía?
steps.en: (the next day, with coffee) Shall we go to the town hall on Monday?

options.es: Vamos los dos. Llevo las fotos del desagüe.
options.en: Let us both go. I will take the photos of the drain.
options.feedback: The anger has slept a night and now it has a plan and a piece of evidence. That is the other half of ni modo.
Agreed. Turning up with nothing in your hand is the eleven trips Marcos already made.

options.es: ¿Para qué? No van a hacer nada.
options.en: What for? They will not do anything.
options.feedback: Yesterday you wanted to complain. Ni modo is not supposed to arrive the day after.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Puso música ayer con la casa mojada. ¿Te fijaste?
steps.en: You noticed I put music on yesterday with the house wet?

options.es: Me fijé. Creo que esa era la otra mitad.
options.en: I noticed. I think that was the other half of it.
options.feedback: You worked out that the song and the ni modo were the same thing. Almost nobody from outside gets that.

options.en: Yes, I thought it was odd.
options.feedback: Honest. It leaves her to explain something you nearly understood.

options.en: Yes, it was not the moment.
options.feedback: It was exactly the moment, and telling her so takes something from her.
